description: This file defines a PHP class 'smpl_Quote_Sample' that generates a quote PDF template with methods for returning the template body, header, and footer.

classes.name: smpl_Quote_Sample
classes.description: A class for generating a quote PDF template including methods for body, header, and footer content.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the object, which is 'AOS_Quotes'.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML content for the PDF of the quote, formatted as a styled table with dynamic data placeholders.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns an empty string as the header content.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Generates and returns the footer HTML containing the page number and date formatted according to locale preference.
